name: torah-study
description: Personal Torah study app: daily study, Siddur path, specialized paths, AI study coach. npm-workspaces monorepo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @torah/api" "npm run dev -w @torah/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @torah/api" "npm run dev:lan -w @torah/web"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm run start -w @torah/api
